Skip this place if you are used to good, authentic Italian food. It will not meet your expectations unfortunately.
Dec 2025 • Couples
So I will start with the good - the pizza base. This place does a good pizza base, it was tasty and well cooked. The most pleasing aspect of our dinner here. 
Our choice of topping was not the best though. We went for a prawn pizza and the seaweed on it was too overpowering for our palettes. 
Service here was ok, waitstaff were friendly and efficient. 
Unfortunately our dining experience here was not enjoyable though due to the food. 
Cheese sticks came out still frozen in the centre (they did take them away & provide hot ones) and were absolutely tasteless. There was no dipping sauce provided with them. Not edible. 
I ordered a seafood pasta that I did not enjoy one bit. I do not know what the sauce base was but it was definitely not the type of tomato base you would expect in an Italian restaurant. 
If you are a tourist and looking for a pizza or pasta alternative from Vietnamese food on your travels - don’t bother. Skip this as if you are used to good Italian food you will be sorely disappointed. When in Vietnam, stick to the local cuisine, it’s what they have perfected and we were never left unsatisfied with our food when choosing that option.

Nice pizza
Jan 2026 • Friends
Italiani’s Pizza offers a pleasant dining experience with a strong Italian vibe. The pizza crust was well-baked, slightly crispy on the outside and soft inside, with generous toppings and good-quality cheese. The flavors were simple but authentic, making the dishes easy to enjoy. Other items on the menu were also prepared carefully and served nicely. The staff were attentive and professional, always checking if everything was okay without being intrusive. Service was smooth, and the waiting time was reasonable. Overall, it’s a great place for casual meals with friends or family, especially if you enjoy classic Italian-style pizza - Chloe
